SETTINGS.TITLE: Google Maps
SETTINGS.TEXT: With the key, client places, Schedule service order and the Calendar show Google Street View and street map. Without it, the OpenStreetMap map is shown, without Street View.
SETTINGS.TEST_HINT: If the frame shows an error, check the steps on the side (API enabled and site restriction).
SETTINGS.STEP_1: In Google Cloud, in the same project where you enabled the Maps JavaScript API, also enable the Maps Embed API (free) and the Directions API (used only when someone taps Show route).
SETTINGS.STEP_2: In APIs & Services > Credentials, create an API key (or use the one you already have).
SETTINGS.STEP_3: Restrict the key: Websites (HTTP referrers) with the Chatwoot address, e.g. https://your-chatwoot.com/*, and the APIs Maps Embed API, Maps JavaScript API and Directions API.
SETTINGS.STEP_4: Paste the key here and click Save. It is visible in the browser of whoever uses the account, so the restriction in step 3 matters.
SETTINGS.MAP_ID: Vector Map ID (optional, for the 3D view)
SETTINGS.MAP_ID_HINT: Without a Map ID the map works normally, only without the 3D view.
SETTINGS.STEP_5: For the 3D view (optional): in Google Maps Platform > Map management, create a JavaScript, Vector Map ID with tilt and rotation checked, and paste the ID in the Map ID field.
